IC1: All infertile women treated with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) [OR]/Fertilization in Vitro and Embryo Transfer (FIVET)
IC2: Less than or equal to (<=) 1 previous failed embryo transfer
IC4: Basal follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) <=12 International unit per liter (IU/L)
IC5: Anti-mullerian hormone (AMH) greater than (>) 1.1 nanogram per milliliter (ng/mL)
IC6: Ovarian Reserve: number of antral follicles 2 millimeter (mm) between 6 <= antral follicle count (AFC) <= 16
IC7: Follicles > 16 mm at the triggering day between 5-14
IC8: Body Mass Index (BMI) between 18 <= BMI <= 27 kilogram per meter square (kg/m^2)
IC10: Normal uterine cavity on ultrasound exam (e.g., [NOT] no presence of hydrosalpinx)
IC11: Undergoing Assisted Reproductive Technique (ART) and oocyte maturation [AND] by human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) triggering
IC12: Progesterone (P4) serum level at the HCG triggering day <= 1.5 ng/mL (Day O/Randomization)
IC13: Estradiol (E2) <= 3000 picogram/milliliter (pg/mL) at the human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) triggering day (Day 0/Randomization)
IC14: Subjects must have read and signed the Informed Consent Form prior to study-specific-procedures not part of standard of care
IC15: Other protocol defined inclusion criteria could apply
